title: Appraisal Side Cross-Notice: The Deduction for the Papers on a Traded Stone
content:
What is deducted from a valuation under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes for the papers on the stone turns on the certificate recorded on the registration and on whether the report the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services register carries for the piece names a laboratory.

## The notice

Where a certificate stands on the registration and the report the appraisal register carries for the piece names a laboratory, nothing is deducted for the certificate (0 percent). Where a certificate stands but that report names no laboratory, ten percent (10 percent) is deducted. Where no certificate stands on the registration at all, the deduction is the one the programme publishes for a missing certificate.

The report the register carries for the piece is its issued report for that piece, and it names a laboratory where a laboratory is recorded on it.

## The three lines

| Certificate on the registration | Issued report names a laboratory | Deduction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | nothing |
| yes | no | 10 percent |
| no | either | the programme's published deduction for a missing certificate |

The programme's published deduction for a missing certificate is 0 percent under the Belrose Standard Trade-In, 100 percent under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee, the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee and the Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege, 25 percent under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee and 18 percent under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme.

## Readings on a figure of 8000 USD

- A certificate on the registration and a report naming a laboratory: 8000.00 USD stands.
- A certificate on the registration but a report naming none: 10 percent is deducted, leaving 7200.00 USD.
- No certificate on the registration, under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee: 25 percent is deducted, leaving 6000.00 USD.
